_README: Which background template to show on which date. To use: add a line under 'dates' with the date (YYYY-MM-DD) and the template name. Template name must match a file in assets/templates/ WITHOUT the .png (e.g. 'universal' -> assets/templates/universal.png). Any date NOT listed here uses 'default' below. NOTE: the universal.png and resort.png files are OLD PLACEHOLDERS with an outdated layout - do NOT schedule them until real templates are built at 1086x1448 matching disney.png.
